description_en: Queries the interactive commands in a specified cluster
description_zh: 调用ListCommands查看指定集群内的交互命令列表
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-commands --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --command-id c-hz01v8vudql0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCommands

parameters.description_en:
